Date range:Last 7 days

## AI bot & crawler traffic

## AI user agents found in robots.txt

## Adoption of AI agent standards

[Copy link](#adoption-of-ai-agent-standards)

Standards adoption across  of the top 200,000 scanned domains

[Learn more...](https://isitagentready.com)Share this...More actions...

Domain category

Select...

[Scan your website for agent readiness](https://isitagentready.com)

These checks measure adoption of AI agent standards across successfully scanned domains. Out of the top 200,000, we exclude categories not meaningful for agent readiness analysis — such as Search Engines, or Empty and Unreachable infrastructure. Not all standards are applicable to every website — for example, x402 is only relevant for sites with paid content, and WebMCP for sites exposing tools to AI agents.

## Workers AI model popularity

[Copy link](#workers-ai-model-popularity)

Distribution of AI model usage on Cloudflare Workers AI

[Learn more...](https://developers.cloudflare.com/radar/glossary/#workers-ai)Share this...More actions...

---

[Copy link](#workers-ai-task-popularity)

Distribution of AI tasks performed on Cloudflare Workers AI

[Learn more...](https://developers.cloudflare.com/radar/glossary/#workers-ai)Share this...More actions...

## Latest AI blog posts

[Copy link](#latest-ai-blog-posts)

Posts tagged with "AI" from the Cloudflare blog

[Cloudflare Blog](https://blog.cloudflare.com/tag/ai/)

## [When scanners miss the attack: how Cloudflare Client-Side Security protects storefronts](https://blog.cloudflare.com/client-side-security-finds-4-malicious-campaigns/)

A modern storefront can look healthy while malicious JavaScript quietly siphons revenue, hijacks clicks, or rewrites analytics. See how Cloudflare's machine learning models surface evasive client-side attacks for analyst investigation.

Sep 2026

## [Have it both ways: stay discoverable in search while disallowing AI training](https://blog.cloudflare.com/accountable-mixed-use-ai-crawlers/)

Cloudflare is giving site owners a way to stay discoverable while disallowing AI training. New controls and an Accountable designation establish a shared model with Apple, Google, and Microsoft.

- [AI](https://blog.cloudflare.com/tag/ai/)
- [AI Bots](https://blog.cloudflare.com/tag/ai-bots/)

- [Product News](https://blog.cloudflare.com/tag/product-news/)
- [Security](https://blog.cloudflare.com/tag/security/)

Bryan Becker

Sep 2026

## [How Cloudflare detects MCP traffic and helps secure it](https://blog.cloudflare.com/mcp-security-updates/)

Cloudflare Gateway identifies MCP requests using protocol-level heuristics. Security teams can use that signal to find shadow MCP traffic, enforce Portal-only access for approved servers, and block direct connections on managed network paths.
